svg.title: A countermodel of ∀x. (p(x) ∨ q(x)) ⊢ ∃x. p(x)
svg.desc: A finite structure, drawn as one world. World 0, the model's world, has the element 0, and forces q(0). The structure makes every formula left of ⊢ true and every formula right of it false, so ∀x. (p(x) ∨ q(x)) ⊢ ∃x. p(x) is not valid in intuitionistic logic.
